description: Project types Genisys users build. Resource records tag the types they serve so agents can filter before reading.

types.title: Web application
types.summary: Browser SPA or server-rendered app: routing, state, forms, data fetching, UI components.

types.title: Marketing or content site
types.summary: Landing pages, blogs, static sites, SEO, analytics and CMS-backed content.

types.title: Mobile application
types.summary: iOS/Android via native, React Native/Expo, Flutter or Capacitor.

types.title: Desktop application
types.summary: Electron, Tauri or native desktop apps, packaging, auto-update and OS integration.

types.title: API or backend service
types.summary: HTTP/GraphQL/RPC services, validation, persistence, queues, caching and background jobs.

types.title: Command-line tool
types.summary: Argument parsing, prompts, output formatting, config files and distribution.

types.title: AI agent or LLM application
types.summary: Model SDKs, tool calling, MCP servers, RAG, evaluation, prompt and token optimization.

types.title: Data and analytics
types.summary: Data loading, transformation, SQL engines, notebooks, charts and dashboards.

types.title: E-commerce
types.summary: Catalog, cart, checkout, payments, tax, inventory and storefront platforms.

types.title: SaaS product
types.summary: Multi-tenant apps: auth, billing/subscriptions, email, feature flags, admin and audit.

types.title: Realtime and collaboration
types.summary: WebSockets, presence, CRDT/collaborative editing, chat and notifications.

types.title: DevOps and infrastructure
types.summary: CI/CD, containers, infrastructure as code, observability, secrets and deployment.

types.title: Testing and QA
types.summary: Unit, integration, end-to-end, visual, load and accessibility testing; mocking and fixtures.

types.title: Documentation and knowledge base
types.summary: Docs sites, API references, diagrams, search and markdown tooling.

types.title: Browser and computer automation
types.summary: Headless browsers, scraping within terms, workflow automation and RPA.

types.title: Office documents
types.summary: PDF, Word, spreadsheet and presentation generation, parsing and conversion.

types.title: Image, video and audio
types.summary: Image processing, video editing/transcoding, audio, 3D and creative tooling.

types.title: Finance and accounting
types.summary: Money math, ledgers, invoicing, accounting APIs and financial data.

types.title: Legal and compliance
types.summary: Contracts, e-signature, privacy, consent, accessibility and policy tooling.

types.title: Game or interactive experience
types.summary: Game engines, 2D/3D rendering, physics, input and asset pipelines.

types.title: Security
types.summary: Crypto, secrets scanning, dependency auditing, auth hardening and threat checks.
